svg.title: AgentDoor
svg.desc: AgentDoor: Owner-approved rules, served to people and AI shopping agents over MCP. Evidence: Live agentdoor.shop, MCP over Streamable HTTP, 3 tools; Ed25519 quotes signed and bound to the approved policy; 0 oversold in a simulated rush of 50 customers. Status: live demo.
